obd.dataset: carOBD (Toyota Etios, real OBD-II, 1 Hz, 129 trips)
obd.split: 42% of trips teach the baseline; 18% (calibration) choose each method's settings and set its threshold so <=10% of healthy calibration trips alarm; 40% held out and scored once: healthy, then with faults injected from minute 3

residuals.dataset: carOBD (Toyota Etios, real OBD-II, 1 Hz, 129 trips)

residual_models.map: map_kpa ~ gradient boosting(rpm, throttle_pct, iat_c), fitted on the learning trips' rows
residual_models.timing: timing_deg ~ gradient boosting(rpm, engine_load, coolant_c), fitted on the learning trips' rows
residual_models.stft: stft_pct ~ gradient boosting(rpm, engine_load), fitted on the learning trips' rows

residuals.split: 42% of trips teach the baseline; 18% (calibration) choose each method's settings and set its threshold so <=10% of healthy calibration trips alarm; 40% held out and scored once: healthy, then with faults injected from minute 3

audio.dataset: Hugging Face RashmiKarunarathne/MyDataSet (real engine recordings, 48 kHz)
audio.vehicle_identity: vehicle identity unknown - recording-grouped CV may be optimistic (filenames are <class>_<index>.wav and no metadata was downloaded, so recordings of one vehicle may sit on both sides of a split)

data_inventory.vehicles: not identifiable from filenames or downloaded metadata
data_inventory.note: sample rate, channel count and bit depth are mixed within every class (the pipeline resamples to 24 kHz mono and z-scores each recording, which removes most format differences)

audio.ci_method: 95% percentile intervals from 1000 bootstrap resamples of recordings (seed 0); metrics per window over the resampled recordings' out-of-fold predictions
audio.split: 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording (no recording in both train and test)

healthy_fpr.definition: healthy predicted as any fault / all healthy, on each held-out fold (no abstention); per-class recall and precision are per window

selective.ensemble: Ensemble (mean of SVM, Softmax, ANN, CNN)
selective.threshold_selection: per outer fold, inner 3-fold split grouped by recording on that fold's training recordings only; lowest threshold with recording-level healthy FPR on answered <= 5%
selective.note: curve = every threshold scored on the held-out folds (a description, not used to choose)

transfer.split: the audio suite's grouped folds (no recording in both train and test)

a.description: real only: trained on the fold's real training recordings (the baseline to beat)

c.description: simulator only, domain-randomised (zero-shot); background bank = healthy windows of the fold's training recordings

d.description: CNN pretrained on randomised simulator spectrograms, fine-tuned on the fold's real training windows (6 epochs, lr 5e-4)

e.description: feature models trained on real training windows + randomised simulator windows

cwru.dataset: CWRU bearing data center, 12 kHz drive end, faults 0.007" and 0.021"
cwru.split: leave-one-motor-load-out: train on 3 loads, test on the 4th, all 4 rotations averaged
